CHAPTER.VERS: His foundation is in the holy mountains.
The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
Glorious things are spoken of you, O city of God. Selah.
And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.
The LORD shall count, when he registers the people, that this man was born there. Selah.
As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: all my springs are in you.
